title: Limit Review Decisions on a Personal Sender Account: Time Held at the Current Level
content:
**Standard.** For a limit review request on a Personal Sender Account, time at the current level is counted in calendar days from the date the current level took effect to the request date. When it is fewer than 30 days, 2 business days are added to the counted decision window of the request; when it is at least 30 but fewer than 180 days, 1 business day is added to the counted decision window; when it is 180 days or more, nothing is added for time at the current level.

The date the current level took effect is the level effective date shown on the account record: the activation date for the opening level, or the date of the most recent move to the level now held.

## Tiers

| Calendar days from the date the current level took effect to the request date | Business days added to the counted decision window |
|---|---|
| fewer than 30 | 2 |
| 30 or more, but fewer than 180 | 1 |
| 180 or more | 0 |

## Both sides of each threshold

| Days at the current level | Business days added |
|---|---|
| 29 | 2 |
| 30 | 1 |
| 179 | 1 |
| 180 | 0 |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical dates)

An account moved up to Paloma Enhanced on 1 March and its holder lodges a limit review request for Paloma Premier on 15 April of the same year. From 1 March to 15 April is 45 calendar days: at least 30 but fewer than 180, so 1 business day is added to the counted decision window of that request. Had the request been lodged on 30 March (29 days), 2 business days would have been added; on 28 August (180 days), none.
